description: OpenAI GPT Image 2.6 Flare model resold through the Runway Dev API, supporting PNG, JPEG and WebP generation and reference-guided editing up to 4K, with reasoning effort controls and transparent backgrounds. Billed per image by quality and resolution; the 1:1 square rates are modeled here and wider or taller ratios bill lower, down to 2 credits, plus 1 credit per reference image.
